heading: LOGOS-MODULE-LOADER
text: LOGOS-MODULE-LOADER

heading: Abstract
text: Abstract

heading: Abstract
text: Every Module Loader provider MUST be a local module provider backed by a local module instance.

heading: Abstract
text: Runtime MUST maintain ordinary provider and lifecycle records for that instance.

heading: Abstract
text: An implementation MAY co-locate or statically link Module Loader code, but Runtime MUST represent that code as a direct local module instance.

heading: Abstract
text: Remote facades and host or deployment services that are not module providers MUST NOT be bound as Module Loader providers.

heading: Abstract
text: _module = "logos_module_loader"

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: A language implementation that cannot directly export the canonical C ABI MUST include generated or handwritten adapter code that exports that ABI.

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: The `id`, `hash`, and `hash_suite` values MUST equal the accepted artifact record.

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: Before artifact-controlled code is mapped, Module Loader MUST verify the exact library bytes against `hash` using `hash_suite`.

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: It MUST map the verified bytes without a path-replacement gap, for example by retaining an operating-system handle or using a protected immutable artifact location.

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: Runtime MUST therefore complete execution authorization before invoking `realize`.

heading: 3. Realization Descriptors
text: Realization descriptors MUST NOT contain backend names, process arguments, environment entries, working directories, endpoint requests, permission decisions, package trust decisions, concrete state paths, resource limits, sandbox-strength claims, or audit assertions.

heading: 5.1 State Assignment

heading: 5.1 State Assignment
5.1 State Assignment
text: When `state` is present in a realization request, Module Loader MUST establish the mapping before native initialization and MUST supply the module-visible path through the Interface `state_dir` initialization field.

heading: 5.1 State Assignment
text: For hosted realization, the Module Host MUST receive the mapped directory and pass its module-visible path through the same field.

heading: 5.1 State Assignment
text: When `state` is absent, the ABI caller MUST use the Interface absent representation for `state_dir`.

heading: 5.1 State Assignment
text: Module Loader MUST NOT mutate a shared process environment to deliver per-instance state.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: Module Loader MUST convey that exact listener to the Module Host without rebinding or replacing it.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: The returned `provider_endpoint` MUST identify the address of that Runtime-created listener.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: Runtime MUST perform every Transport and Runtime readiness check before exposing the provider.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: Module Loader MUST NOT advertise a hosted placement unless it can convey the listener through that placement without weakening its isolation.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: A direct realization MUST omit `provider_endpoint`.

heading: 5.3 Hosted Provider Endpoint
text: A consumer-only realization MUST omit `provider_endpoint`.

heading: 5.4 Trusted Transport Adapter Handoff
text: 5.4 Trusted Transport Adapter Handoff

heading: 5.4 Trusted Transport Adapter Handoff
text: Module Loader MAY convey a private invocation channel between a Module Host and a Runtime-controlled Transport adapter outside the module's execution envelope.

heading: 5.4 Trusted Transport Adapter Handoff
text: The handoff MUST preserve the binding to the module instance and its realization, the selected placement's isolation, and existing invocation semantics.

heading: 5.4 Trusted Transport Adapter Handoff
text: It MUST NOT expose Runtime credentials to the Module Host or module.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: 6. Realize Operation

heading: 6. Realize Operation
6. Realize Operation
6. Realize Operation
text: Module Loader MUST bind the realization to that exact identity and MUST NOT derive another module-instance identity from a process, container, endpoint, static binding, artifact, or realization identifier.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Module Loader MUST maintain at most one active or failed realization for one module instance.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: If the same descriptor and private handoffs are already active for the instance, `realize` MUST succeed and return that active realization without creating another context or Module Host.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: If a failed realization created from the same descriptor and private handoffs is retained for the instance, `realize` MUST return a failed response containing that same failed realization without retrying realization or creating another context or Module Host.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: If the instance has a different active or failed realization, `realize` MUST return `instance-conflict`.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: A failed realization must be released before another realization can be created for that module instance.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Module Loader MUST reject a strategy or hosted placement that it did not advertise with `unsupported-strategy`.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: It MUST do so before loading artifact-controlled code.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Before initialization, it MUST:

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … resolve the mandatory ABI symbols for the expected module name;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … require `logos_<module>_name()` to return `descriptor.module`;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … obtain, parse, and validate the provider call surface when provider symbols apply;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … populate the initialization ABI version and structure size;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … supply the consumer-bound Runtime Control binding;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … supply the required event-publication binding;

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … supply `state_dir` and configuration using the handoffs defined above; and

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST satisfy every applicable LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE requirement. Before initialization, it MUST: … set `*out_context` to `NULL` before calling `logos_<module>_init()`.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST reject every initialization result and context combination that LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE does not permit.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The ABI caller MUST retain the accepted binding and use that same context for every instance-dependent ABI operation.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: For hosted provider realization, the Module Host MUST retain the inherited listener without accepting connections until initialization succeeds.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: It then serves that listener through the protected local Transport profile and MUST NOT create, bind, or substitute another provider endpoint.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Module Loader MUST NOT return an active realization until the Module Host confirms that it is serving the inherited listener.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Success MUST return an active realization that satisfies every requested Loader-owned handoff.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: The operation MUST NOT return an intermediate state.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: If realization fails before becoming active, Module Loader MUST clean every partial context, binding, inherited-listener reference, and execution envelope that it can safely clean.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Outside protected initial system-service bootstrap, Runtime MUST obtain authorization for module execution and every required permission before invoking `realize`.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: Module Loader MUST accept security and deployment constraints only from a boundary trusted by the selected profile.

heading: 6. Realize Operation
text: It MUST fail rather than substitute a weaker strategy, placement, isolation mechanism, state mapping, or resource control.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: 9. Release Operation

heading: 9. Release Operation
9. Release Operation
9. Release Operation
text: During graceful release of a live native context, the ABI caller MUST invoke `logos_<module>_destroy(context)` exactly once and wait for it to return before discarding the binding or stopping its execution envelope.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: Forced termination of the execution envelope MAY prevent destruction from beginning or returning.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: A later cleanup attempt MUST NOT invoke destruction again for that context.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: A request containing `force` when the Loader did not advertise `force_release` MUST return a failed response with `invalid-request`.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: It MUST NOT begin cleanup or mutate a retained realization.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: Module Loader MUST match a retained realization against both `realization` and `module_instance`.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: If `realization` identifies a retained record whose `module_instance` does not match the request, Module Loader MUST return a failed response with `realization-not-found` and MUST NOT affect that record or any other realization.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: A release request whose `realization` identifies no retained record is idempotently successful and MUST NOT affect another realization.

heading: 9. Release Operation
text: If cleanup cannot establish absence, Module Loader MUST retain and return a failed realization.

heading: 10. Results And Errors
text: A success variant MUST NOT contain an error or failed realization.

heading: 10. Results And Errors
text: `invalid-request` identifies a semantically invalid request that MUST NOT be retried unchanged.

heading: 10. Results And Errors
text: Such failures MUST NOT be encoded as another Loader-specific error value.

heading: 10. Results And Errors
text: It MUST NOT expose credentials, policy inputs, hidden realization existence, host paths, backend configuration, endpoint secrets, or information the caller is not authorized to observe.

heading: 10. Results And Errors
text: Loader errors are operational results and MUST NOT be interpreted as authorization decisions.

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: 11. Concurrency And Ordering

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: Module Loader MUST apply realization mutations atomically per module instance.

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: The Loader MUST serialize live-configuration application and MUST exclude it from release and other instance-dependent mutation.

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: It MUST NOT combine fields from different states.

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: Module Loader MUST ensure at-most-once destruction for every successfully initialized context.

heading: 11. Concurrency And Ordering
text: Operations for different module instances MAY proceed concurrently subject to the Interface concurrency contract and active resource policy.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: 12. Security Requirements

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: Module Loader MUST verify dynamic-library bytes before mapping them and MUST prevent path replacement between verification and mapping.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: It MUST reject unsupported strategies before artifact-controlled code executes.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: It provides no process memory boundary and MUST be selected only when active policy permits that trust relationship.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: Module Loader MUST establish every control required by the selected security profile and MUST fail rather than silently use a weaker mechanism.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: The hosted Unix-stream endpoint MUST be protected according to the local Transport profile.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: The Module Host MUST serve only the Runtime-created listener conveyed by Module Loader.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: Endpoint possession alone MUST NOT grant provider, route, or method authority.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: Module Loader MUST obtain mappings and access controls from protected deployment input and MUST NOT accept replacements supplied by the module artifact.

heading: 12. Security Requirements
text: Realization records MUST NOT contain configuration values, state assignments, artifact or state paths, process identifiers, sandbox or container references, credentials, grants, policy decisions, or audit material.
